tasks.title: Implement retained application lifecycle and real web readiness integration
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: AP2 / APP-02,APP-03,APP-06,APP-07: retain one start/stop/dispose operation and one host/provider. Start joins preparation and actual host/CIS startup; Run starts, waits for ordinary shutdown and stops, returning an exit result only for observed outcomes with retained cause. Stop signals owned work before actual startup/configuration/heartbeat/REST/metrics drains; disposal handles partial Build/start acquisition and propagates cleanup faults safely. Use native routing/operational branches and existing health/business readiness statuses, real early listener access, required sequential tail bridge order and one host disposal path. Include real-host/ownership tests, docs and review.
tasks.validation: A02–A05/A10: all startup roots constructed before sequential identity-deduplicated starts; repeated/concurrent calls share retained outcomes and terminal stop cannot restart/readiness-reopen. Held real initializer proves health500/business503 then ready200 without side effects. Held work/canceled waits/partial build prove no dependency disposal before actual settlement; original start/cancel/fault and later disposal errors surface correctly.
